fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 2.2 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2019.

instrument_type_details.notes: Per Note 10: primarily uses a mixture of purchased call options, collar structures, call spreads, put spreads, and fixed price swap agreements. Portfolio covers 2019-2022. Net fair value at 12/31/2018 was an asset of $138 million (fuel derivatives designated as hedges: $138M gross asset; no liability fuel derivatives). No cash collateral deposits provided by or held by the Company as of 12/31/2018. Company adopted New Hedging Standard (ASC 815) effective January 1, 2018.

warnings: MD&A hedge table is dated as of January 18, 2019 (not December 31, 2018); reflects forward-looking coverage.
Note 10 gallon volumes are maximum economic hedge and may vary significantly as market prices fluctuate.
2022 pct_hedged stated as 'less than 5%' in MD&A (Beyond 2021 category); recorded as 5 (ceiling estimate).
Company adopted ASU 2017-12 New Hedging Standard effective January 1, 2018, changing hedge accounting treatment.
All volume figures are in gallons (millions) as required.
